name: Hillcross Glider

items.name: Starting Drop
items.text: The only way to launch a Hillcross glider is to jump off a steep incline with favorable wind conditions. The glider is uncontrolled and falls 60 feet each round until the pilot successfully Takes Control. If the glider hits the ground before the pilot Takes Control, the pilot and the glider both take falling damage.

text: Hillcross gliders are made of bone and stretched hide, tied together with sinew, and sealed with a glue made from animal fat.
